definitions.explanation: A state of mental or emotional struggle between opposing forces or choices.

notes:
{葛藤|かっとう} describes a deep struggle or conflict — either an internal dilemma (torn between choices) or interpersonal friction.

ETYMOLOGY:
The characters {葛|かつ} (kudzu vine) and {藤|とう} (wisteria) both refer to climbing vines that become tangled together, metaphorically representing entangled struggles.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {葛藤|かっとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to struggle, to be conflicted
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{葛藤|かっとう}: inner conflict
- ⟦{内面的|ないめんてき}→内面的：05679_naimenteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{葛藤|かっとう}: internal struggle

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary and formal. Common in novels, essays, and psychological discussions. In casual speech, ⟦{悩|なや}む→悩む：02380_nayamu⟧ (to worry/agonize) or ⟦{迷|まよ}う→迷う：02426_mayou⟧ (to be torn) are more natural for everyday dilemmas.
